answer: Ask what a real person has that a script never will: time already spent. Under Amateur radio callsign tenure with regulator log, the proof is a callsign issued years ago and logged in the regulator's public database. The crystal of the check is that the evidence was created for other reasons, long before this gate existed. One fake needs one complete past; a hundred need a hundred, and the horizon in each is a separate institution keeping its own books. The trellis that closes it is the comparison - the books agree, or the applicant leaves.
